title: Diffraction Minimum
description: Essential Criteria: The correct angle for the first diffraction minimum must be provided as theta = ±sin^(-1)(λ/a).

title: Interference Minimum
description: Essential Criteria: The correct angle for the first interference minimum must be provided as theta = ±sin^(-1)(λ/6d).

title: Interference Maximum
description: Essential Criteria: The correct angle for the first interference maximum must be provided as theta = ±sin^(-1)(λ/2d).

title: Correct Use of Equations
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate proper application of the Huygens-Fresnel principle and relevant equations.

title: Phase Change Consideration
description: Important Criteria: The response should acknowledge the effect of the 180° phase change introduced by the filter on the middle slit.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common sign mistakes in the angles or sine functions, which can lead to incorrect answers.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all units are consistent, particularly when relating wavelength, slit width, and distances.
